{'article': '據報 Apple 明年嘅 iPhone Pro 型號將會有重大重新設計，ETNews 一篇新報導就概述咗呢個「近乎無邊框」設計同埋屏幕嘅預期細節。', 'index': 0, 'translation': 'Apple is reportedly planning a major redesign for next year\'s iPhone Pro models, with a new report from ETNews outlining the expected details of this "nearly bezel-less" design and display.'}

{'article': 'iPhone Pro 20週年紀念型號將保留獨特設計，但就缺少之前傳聞嘅部分屏幕升級', 'index': 1, 'translation': 'iPhone Pro 20th Anniversary Edition Will Keep Its Unique Design But Miss Some Of The Rumored Display Upgrades'}

{'article': 'iPhone 18 Pro 上星期先至登場，iPhone Duo 下個月就跟住出。不過考慮到 Apple iPhone 開發嘅長周期，提早傳出下一代嘅消息都唔算早。', 'index': 2, 'translation': "The iPhone 18 Pro only just launched last week, and the iPhone Duo is following next month. But given Apple's long iPhone development cycles, it's not too early for next-generation rumors."}

{'article': '我哋好耐之前就聽講 Apple 準備為明年嘅 20週年紀念 iPhone Pro 型號設計獨特外觀，今日 ETNews 一篇新報導就提供咗最新嘅預期詳情。', 'index': 3, 'translation': "We heard a long time ago that Apple is preparing a distinctive design for next year's 20th anniversary iPhone Pro, and today a new report from ETNews provides the latest expected details."}

{'article': '金英浩（Kim Yeong-ho）撰文指，Apple「仍然預期會採用四邊彎曲屏幕」，呢種屏幕「透過將顯示面板沿智能手機四邊彎曲，營造出近乎無邊框嘅全屏幕觀感」。', 'index': 4, 'translation': 'Writing for ETNews, Kim Yeong-ho says Apple "is still expected to adopt a four-sided curved display," a display that "creates a nearly bezel-less, full-screen appearance by bending the display panel along all four sides of the smartphone."'}

{'article': '所以 20週年紀念型號嘅標誌性特徵睇落仍然穩陣落實，唔似華爾街券商 Jefferies 上個月所表達嘅質疑。', 'index': 5, 'translation': 'So the signature feature of the 20th anniversary model still appears to be firmly in place, unlike the doubts expressed last month by Wall Street brokerage Jefferies.'}

{'article': '不過 ETNews 亦指出，之前為新 iPhone Pro 型號考慮嘅兩項屏幕技術最終唔會採用。', 'index': 6, 'translation': 'However, ETNews also points out that two display technologies previously considered for the new iPhone Pro models will ultimately not be used.'}

{'article': '呢兩項技術本來可以分別令屏幕更薄同埋更加慳電。', 'index': 7, 'translation': 'These two technologies could have respectively made the display thinner and more power-efficient.'}

{'article': '業界消息人士將 Apple 嘅決定歸咎於兩個主要原因：記憶體價格上升令 Apple 更難將額外屏幕成本內部消化，以及公司希望搵到比現行 COE 同 LTPO+ 方案更優勝嘅替代方案。', 'index': 8, 'translation': "Industry sources attribute Apple's decision to two main reasons: rising memory prices have made it harder for Apple to absorb additional display costs internally, and the company wants to find alternatives superior to current COE and LTPO+ solutions."}

{'article': '睇落呢兩項升級本身都唔算太革命性。用戶明顯更加關心嘅係全新「近乎無邊框」設計仍然得以保留。', 'index': 9, 'translation': 'Neither of these upgrades seems particularly revolutionary on its own. What users clearly care about more is that the new "nearly bezel-less" design has been preserved.'}

{'article': '你對 20週年紀念 iPhone Pro 型號有幾大興趣？歡迎留言講下你嘅睇法。', 'index': 10, 'translation': 'How interested are you in the 20th anniversary iPhone Pro? Drop us a comment with your thoughts.'}
